mapper.select: SELECT C.COMMENT_NUM AS commentNum, C.POST_NUM AS postNum, C.USER_NUM AS userNum, C.COMMENT_CONTENT AS commentContent, TO_CHAR(C.COMMENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS commentDate, U.USER_NICKNAME AS userNickname FROM T_COMMENT C JOIN T_USER U ON C.USER_NUM = U.USER_NUM WHERE C.POST_NUM = #{postNum} ORDER BY C.COMMENT_NUM ASC
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_T_COMMENT.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO T_COMMENT ( COMMENT_NUM, POST_NUM, USER_NUM, COMMENT_CONTENT ) VALUES ( #{commentNum}, #{postNum}, #{userNum}, #{commentContent} )
mapper.update: UPDATE T_COMMENT SET COMMENT_CONTENT = #{commentContent}, COMMENT_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE COMMENT_NUM = #{commentNum}
